'''Aron Eisenberg''' was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 1999]], billed as Nog from ''Star Trek: Deep Space Nine''.<ref name="guests">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback 22 January 2000)</ref> Decipher photographed him signing autographs, with Tournaments Coordinator [[Bruce Umene]] at the same table.<ref name="fri30">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000612184011/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri30.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri30], Decipher (Wayback 12 June 2000). Caption: "Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene does the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs"</ref> Star Trek CCG held its third World Championship at the convention, won by Mike Harrington, and Young Jedi held its World Championship, won by Greg Heisler.<ref name="sat">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Lalumiere Saturday], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback 20 November 2000)</ref>
